Official Ballot Drop Box Sites and Early Voting Information

Important Notice! Locations are subject to change.

November 3, 2026, General Election

Early Voting at the Registrar of Voters Office​​​​​

1555 Berger Drive, Building 2, San Jose, CA 95112

Monday - FridayOctober 5, 2026 – November 2, 2026​​8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.​        
​Saturday​ and Sunday

October 24, 2026 – October 25, 2026

October 31, 2026 - November 1, 2026

​9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

The Berger Drive office will be closed Monday, October 12, 2026

​Election DayNovember 3, 2026​7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
 

24 Hour Official Ballot Drop Box – October 2, 2026 – November 2, 2026,            

until 8 p.m. Election Day November 3, 2026

Registrar of ​Voters schedule to collect ballots from drop boxes:​​​​                                                          
October 5, 2026 – October 16, 2026: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday​​           
October 19, 2026 - November 3, 2026: Daily​

You can find ballot drop off locations for the November 3, 2026 General Election, below.
